meta.task: Cost to complete albums A001-A016 (QUEUE_grok.md NEW 2026-10-10 evening, item 1)
meta.grade_policy: Coins dated before 1965: XF (circulated album fill). 1965 and later: UNC (roll / mint fill). Where the Numista row does not price that grade, the nearest grade given is used, the grade field says which, and confidence is low.
meta.price_source: Numista type-page value tables (USD, fetched 2026-10-10 19:2x-19:4x PT from the box). PCGS (Cloudflare 403) and NGC (prices load by script) could not be read, so none are used.
meta.melt_floor: Silver never below melt: xag_usd 60.949001 (data/prices.json latest, 2026-10-10 22:28 UTC). ASW oz: dime 0.0723 ($4.41), quarter 0.1808 ($11.02), Kennedy 90% 0.3617 ($22.05), Kennedy 40% 0.1479 ($9.01), wartime nickel 0.05626 ($3.43).
meta.excluded: Printed 'Issued only in mint sets' circles are not holes: A002 2019-W, A004 1996-W, A007 1970-D, A013 2020-W.
meta.confidence: med = the page prices that exact grade for that exact date and mint; low = nearest grade used.
